description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for verifying subproject functionality within a Git repository. It uses test-lib.sh for common testing utilities and performs operations such as creating subprojects, committing changes, checking repository integrity with git fsck, and testing git diff and clone behaviors involving subprojects.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution based on a description and a set of commands.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual files to verify correctness.
